answer.prose: Base token n with a single exponent of 5, i.e. n^5: the exponent slot holds the positive integer 5 and the base slot holds n.
Base token n with a single exponent of 3, i.e. n^3: the exponent slot holds the positive integer 3 and the base slot holds n.
Coefficient 2 times a square root of radicand 3 with root index 2, i.e. 2*sqrt(3): coefficient slot 2, radicand slot 3, index slot 2.
Coefficient 5 times a square root of radicand 13 with root index 2, i.e. 5*sqrt(13): coefficient slot 5, radicand slot 13, index slot 2.
Coefficient 8 times a square root of radicand 6 with root index 2, i.e. 8*sqrt(6): coefficient slot 8, radicand slot 6, index slot 2.
Coefficient 8 times a square root of radicand 7 with root index 2, i.e. 8*sqrt(7): coefficient slot 8, radicand slot 7, index slot 2.
Base x with exponent numerator 8 and denominator 15, i.e. x^(8/15), already in lowest terms since 8 and 15 share no factor.
Base x with exponent numerator 3 and denominator 4, i.e. x^(3/4), already in lowest terms.
Base x with exponent numerator 4 and denominator 3, i.e. x^(4/3).
Base x with exponent numerator 2 and denominator 5, i.e. x^(2/5).
Radicand slot holds x^3 (base x, power 3) under a root whose index slot is 4, i.e. root(x^3, 4), the fourth root of x cubed.
Radicand slot holds x^4 (base x, power 4) under a root whose index slot is 5, i.e. root(x^4, 5), the fifth root of x to the fourth.
